thought: Confirmed. This is the Unitree H1 humanoid: a floating base (freejoint) + 19 actuated hinge joints, all `motor` (torque) actuators, no gripper, no weld/equality constraints, and no dedicated end-effector site (only an `imu` site on the torso). The arm chain of interest for reaching is the shoulder/elbow set, with elbow links serving as end-effectors.
